voiceover: Apologia Daily has two AI tutors on every essay and evidence card — and together they change how you learn the faith. Tutor one: Ask AI Tutor. Hit a question mid-argument — what does that mean? isn't this circular? — and just ask. It answers in plain English, grounded in the certified text of the page you're reading — not random answers off the internet. Tutor two, brand new: Teach me this. Instead of giving you the answer, it teaches you to build the argument yourself. One short question at a time, step by step, until you've reasoned the whole case out — so you can explain it in your own words. Both are grounded in the certified page you're reading. Both stay inside the historic creeds — gentle, honest, and accurate. And if you're ever hurting, both stop and point you to real help. Ask it, or be taught by it. Two tutors for the hardest questions of the faith — free, on every essay and card.
